mapper.sql: CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_SN IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN C.EQPMNT_SN IS NULL OR C.CLCT_DT IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN C.CNTN_YN = 'N' OR C.CLCT_DT < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL COALESCE(CAST((SELECT U.UI_STNG_VL FROM ui_stng_info U WHERE U.UI_STNG_CD = 'DASHBOARD_OFFLINE_MIN' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y') AS UNSIGNED), 5) MINUTE) THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN C.STTS_CD = 'OFFLINE' THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN C.STTS_CD = 'WARNING' THEN 'CAUTION' ELSE COALESCE(C.STTS_CD, 'UNKNOWN') END

LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_perf_stts CPU ON CPU.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN AND CPU.PERF_IDCT_CD = 'CPU_USGRT' LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_perf_stts MMRY ON MMRY.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN AND MMRY.PERF_IDCT_CD = 'MMRY_USGRT' LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_perf_stts IFU ON IFU.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN AND IFU.PERF_IDCT_CD = 'IF_USE_NOCS' LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_perf_stts IFT ON IFT.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN AND IFT.PERF_IDCT_CD = 'IF_TOTAL_NOCS'

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R.EQPMNT_SN, GROUP_CONCAT(CAST(R.LSE_EQPMNT_SN AS CHAR) ORDER BY R.LSE_EQPMNT_SN SEPARATOR ',') AS LSE_EQPMNT_SNS_CSV, GROUP_CONCAT(LSE.EQPMNT_NM ORDER BY LSE.EQPMNT_NM SEPARATOR ', ') AS LSE_EQPMNT_NMS FROM pids_eqpmnt_lse_rel R JOIN eqpmnt_info LSE ON LSE.EQPMNT_SN = R.LSE_EQPMNT_SN AND LSE.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY R.EQPMNT_SN ) PR ON PR.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN
mapper.select: SELECT S.LINK_SYS_CD, S.LINK_SYS_NM, COUNT(E.EQPMNT_SN) AS TOTAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('CAUTION','WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CAUTION_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, 0 AS OFFLINE_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_SN IS NOT NULL AND = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNKNOWN_NOCS, MAX(C.CLCT_DT) AS LAST_CLCT_DT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('CAUTION','WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_SN IS NOT NULL AND = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS STTS_CD FROM link_sys_info S LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.LINK_SYS_CD = S.LINK_SYS_CD AND E.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_stts C ON C.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY S.LINK_SYS_CD, S.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY FIELD(S.LINK_SYS_CD, 'VMS','PBX','SCADA_SEC','EMS_PIDS','EMS_TX')

SELECT S.STN_CD, S.STN_NM, S.STN_SEQ, S.MNLS_STN_YN, COUNT(E.EQPMNT_SN) AS TOTAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('CAUTION','WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CAUTION_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, 0 AS OFFLINE_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_SN IS NOT NULL AND = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNKNOWN_NOCS, MAX(C.CLCT_DT) AS LAST_CLCT_DT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('CAUTION','WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_SN IS NOT NULL AND = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS STTS_CD FROM stn_info S LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.STN_CD = S.STN_CD AND E.USE_YN = 'Y' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd} LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_stts C ON C.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY S.STN_CD, S.STN_NM, S.STN_SEQ, S.MNLS_STN_YN ORDER BY S.STN_SEQ

SELECT E.EQPMNT_SN, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO, E.EQPMNT_NM, E.EQPMNT_SE_CD, E.EQPMNT_CLSF_CD, F.EQPMNT_CLSF_NM, E.LINK_SYS_CD, L.LINK_SYS_NM, E.EMS_ID, E.STN_CD, S.STN_NM, E.INSTL_PLC_NM, E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR, E.MAC_ADDR, E.EQPMNT_MDL_NM, E.EQPMNT_EXPLN, C.CNTN_YN, V.FLR_NM, V.CMRA_QTY, P.EQPM_NM AS PBX_EQPM_NM, P.CMPNT_NM, P.MTBF_HR, CPU.MSRMT_VL AS CPU_USGRT, MMRY.MSRMT_VL AS MMRY_USGRT, CAST(IFU.MSRMT_VL AS UNSIGNED) AS IF_USE_NOCS, CAST(IFT.MSRMT_VL AS UNSIGNED) AS IF_TOTAL_NOCS, PR.LSE_EQPMNT_SNS_CSV, PR.LSE_EQPMNT_NMS, C.PING_RSPNS_MS, AS STTS_CD, COALESCE((SELECT CC.COM_CD_NM FROM com_cd_info CC WHERE CC.COM_CD_GROUP_ID = 'SYS_STTS' AND CC.COM_CD = AND CC.COM_CD_USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1), ) AS STTS_NM, C.STTS_EXPLN, C.LAST_RSPNS_DT, C.CLCT_DT, E.USE_YN, E.REG_DT, E.MDFCN_DT FROM eqpmnt_info E JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD = E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD = E.STN_CD LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_clsf_info F ON F.EQPMNT_CLSF_CD = E.EQPMNT_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_stts C ON C.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN cctv_info V ON V.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN pbx_info P ON P.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN
WHERE E.USE_YN = 'Y' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd} AND E.STN_CD = #{stnCd}
AND (E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR E.EQPMNT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ, 999), E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO

SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD, L.LINK_SYS_NM, COUNT(E.EQPMNT_SN) AS TOTAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('CAUTION','WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CAUTION_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, 0 AS OFFLINE_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_SN IS NOT NULL AND = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UNKNOWN_NOCS, MAX(C.CLCT_DT) AS LAST_CLCT_DT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IN ('CAUTION','WARNING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN E.EQPMNT_SN IS NOT NULL AND = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS STTS_CD FROM link_sys_info L LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.LINK_SYS_CD = L.LINK_SYS_CD AND E.STN_CD = #{_parameter} AND E.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_stts C ON C.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN WHERE L.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD, L.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD, 'VMS','PBX','SCADA_SEC','EMS_PIDS','EMS_TX')

SELECT E.*, L.LINK_SYS_NM, S.STN_NM, F.EQPMNT_CLSF_NM, V.FLR_NM, V.CMRA_QTY, P.EQPM_NM AS PBX_EQPM_NM, P.CMPNT_NM, P.MTBF_HR, CPU.MSRMT_VL AS CPU_USGRT, MMRY.MSRMT_VL AS MMRY_USGRT, CAST(IFU.MSRMT_VL AS UNSIGNED) AS IF_USE_NOCS, CAST(IFT.MSRMT_VL AS UNSIGNED) AS IF_TOTAL_NOCS, PR.LSE_EQPMNT_SNS_CSV, PR.LSE_EQPMNT_NMS, C.CNTN_YN, C.PING_RSPNS_MS, AS STTS_CD, C.STTS_EXPLN, C.LAST_RSPNS_DT, C.CLCT_DT FROM eqpmnt_info E JOIN link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD = E.LINK_SYS_CD LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD = E.STN_CD LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_clsf_info F ON F.EQPMNT_CLSF_CD = E.EQPMNT_CLSF_CD LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_stts C ON C.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN cctv_info V ON V.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN LEFT JOIN pbx_info P ON P.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN
WHERE E.EQPMNT_SN = #{_parameter} AND E.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT E.EQPMNT_SN, E.EQPMNT_MNG_NO, E.EQPMNT_NM, E.EQPMNT_SE_CD, E.LINK_SYS_CD, E.STN_CD, S.STN_NM, E.INSTL_PLC_NM, E.EQPMNT_IP_ADDR, E.EQPMNT_EXPLN, E.USE_YN FROM eqpmnt_info E LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD = E.STN_CD WHERE E.USE_YN = 'Y' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD = 'EMS_PIDS' AND (UPPER(E.EQPMNT_SE_CD) = 'LSE' OR UPPER(E.EQPMNT_NM) LIKE '%LSE%') AND E.STN_CD = #{stnCd} ORDER BY COALESCE(S.STN_SEQ, 999), E.EQPMNT_NM

SELECT R.FROM_EQPMNT_SN, F.EQPMNT_NM AS FROM_EQPMNT_NM, R.TO_EQPMNT_SN, T.EQPMNT_NM AS TO_EQPMNT_NM, R.LINK_TYPE_CD, R.LINK_NM FROM eqpmnt_lnk_rel R JOIN eqpmnt_info F ON F.EQPMNT_SN = R.FROM_EQPMNT_SN AND F.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN eqpmnt_info T ON T.EQPMNT_SN = R.TO_EQPMNT_SN AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND F.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd} AND T.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd} AND (F.STN_CD = #{stnCd} OR T.STN_CD = #{stnCd}) ORDER BY R.REG_DT, R.FROM_EQPMNT_SN, R.TO_EQPMNT_SN LIMIT 100

SELECT H.ENEX_EVNT_SN, H.EQPMNT_SN, E.EQPMNT_NM, S.STN_NM, H.EVNT_CD, H.EVNT_NM, DATE_FORMAT(H.ENEX_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS ENEX_DT, H.ENEX_RSLT_CD, H.APRV_YN, H.EVNT_CN FROM enex_evnt_hstry H JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN = H.EQPMNT_SN AND E.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN stn_info S ON S.STN_CD = E.STN_CD WHERE E.LINK_SYS_CD = 'SCADA_SEC' AND E.STN_CD = #{stnCd} ORDER BY H.ENEX_DT DESC, H.ENEX_EVNT_SN DESC LIMIT 8
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eqpmnt_info (EQPMNT_MNG_NO, EQPMNT_NM, EQPMNT_SE_CD, EQPMNT_CLSF_CD, LINK_SYS_CD, EMS_ID, STN_CD, INSTL_PLC_NM, EQPMNT_IP_ADDR, MAC_ADDR, EQPMNT_MDL_NM, EQPMNT_EXPLN, PING_MNTR_YN, PING_CYCLE_SEC, USE_YN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{eqpmntMngNo}, #{eqpmntNm}, #{eqpmntSeCd}, #{eqpmntClsfCd}, #{linkSysCd}, #{emsId}, #{stnCd}, #{instlPlcNm}, #{eqpmntIpAddr}, #{macAddr}, #{eqpmntMdlNm}, #{eqpmntExpln}, 'Y', 30, #{useYn}, #{rgtrId})
mapper.update: UPDATE eqpmnt_info SET EQPMNT_MNG_NO = #{eqpmntMngNo}, EQPMNT_NM = #{eqpmntNm}, EQPMNT_SE_CD = #{eqpmntSeCd}, EQPMNT_CLSF_CD = #{eqpmntClsfCd}, LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd}, EMS_ID = #{emsId}, STN_CD = #{stnCd}, INSTL_PLC_NM = #{instlPlcNm}, EQPMNT_IP_ADDR = #{eqpmntIpAddr}, MAC_ADDR = #{macAddr}, EQPMNT_MDL_NM = #{eqpmntMdlNm}, EQPMNT_EXPLN = #{eqpmntExpln}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} WHERE EQPMNT_SN = #{eqpmntSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
UPDATE eqpmnt_info SET USE_YN = 'N', MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} WHERE EQPMNT_SN = #{eqpmntSn} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pids_eqpmnt_lse_rel (EQPMNT_SN, LSE_EQPMNT_SN, REG_DT) SELECT #{eqpmntSn}, #{lseEqpmntSn}, NOW() FROM eqpmnt_info P, eqpmnt_info L WHERE P.EQPMNT_SN = #{eqpmntSn} AND L.EQPMNT_SN = #{lseEqpmntSn} AND P.LINK_SYS_CD = 'EMS_PIDS' AND L.LINK_SYS_CD = 'EMS_PIDS' AND (UPPER(L.EQPMNT_SE_CD) = 'LSE' OR UPPER(L.EQPMNT_NM) LIKE '%LSE%') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE REG_DT = VALUES(REG_DT)
